messages:
maria: Quick triage — noticed a host-side latency sink on nano-prod after kernel-selector rollout. p50 up ~25ms for short chat requests (seq < 64). Anyone else seeing this?

jordan: Yea canary lit up earlier. p75/p95 also shifted. Saw same on loadgen. https://perf.internal/fg/3241598765 :eyes:

lee: Uploaded pprof (cpu+alloc). Flame shows heavy time in http2::frame::parse and tokenizer allocations around request parse.

perf-bot: alert: host_ingress_latency_regression detected (p50 +9ms, p95 +34ms) — triggered 2026-03-22T15:07Z

sam: I think the kernel-selector change bumped small-request path into a kernel that expects fewer syscalls but does more CPU per token; combined with new minibatch policy we're doing extra coalesce/decouple work.

maria: Raw numbers from quick run (small chat payload):
baseline: p50 42ms, p95 120ms, kv_hit 87%
after-rollout: p50 67ms, p95 159ms, kv_hit 83%

lee: Interesting kv_hit dropped — maybe kvcache warm eviction due to different batching semantics. Also tokenizer alloc churn + writev scatter.

sam: Proposed mitigations:
1) revert kernel-selector heuristic for seq<64 (fast rollback path)
2) reuse tokenizer buffer (avoid per-request malloc)
3) tweak minibatch min_fill from 0.2 -> 0.1 for latency endpoints
4) add short-window KV cache pinning for recently seen prefixes

maria: Patch plan ok. Quick patch for #2 and #3 to land as hotfix. #1 as rollback toggle behind feature flag.

jordan: I'll take #2 (tokenizer reuse) — small change, low risk.

lee: I'll prototype a KV pin (advisory pin) — needs extra telemetry to measure effect.

sam: For testing, run this repro command against canary:

``
wrk -t12 -c200 -d60s -s scripts/small_chat.lua http://canary-host:8080/generate
``

maria: Can we also enable streaming-coalesce on the host to reduce HTTP/gRPC smallwrite overhead? It helped in previous smallwrite regressions.

jordan: Yep can toggle streaming.coalesce=true in canary config. Doing it now.

perf-bot: deploy: canary config updated by jordan (streaming.coalesce=true)

lee: Quick microbench after coalesce + tokenizer buffer reuse (local): p50 48ms, p95 132ms, kv_hit 86% — closer to baseline.

maria: Great. Let's land tokenizer reuse hotfix, enable rollback flag for kernel selector, and monitor telemetry for 2 hours. I'll open a short PR tracker and assign owners.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/1427 — includes tokenizer reuse + batching tweak

jordan: landed canary toggle. monitoring dashboards -> https://dashboards.internal/ingress/3241598765

lee: adding focused traces for kvcache evictions. Will post results in this thread.

maria: Thanks team — next check-in in 30m. :thumbsup:
